title: Crownfall Kart
tagline: Figure-eight skybridges, fortress switchbacks and a sixty-metre spiral. Drift, jump and boost through short cursed-kart sprints with a layered synth soundtrack.

multiplayer.notes: Solo with AI works offline. Online races, Grand Prix and balloon battle use the game's WebSocket server loaded by npm start. Empty seats are AI. Time trials are solo with a locally saved personal-best ghost.
